text.p: -- Alex. Brown & Sons reiterated a strong buy recommendation on Agouron Pharmaceuticals Inc.
-- cited Agouron's announcement that it would buy Alanex Corp, a privately held drug discovery company, for one million shares of newly issued Agouron stock.
-- expects the deal to be modestly dilutive to Agouron's earnings due to the new shares to be issued.
-- expects Agouron to earn $0.13 a share in 1998.
-- said trimmed the 1999 estimate to $3.80 a share from $4.07 a share and cut the year 2000 estimate to $4.93 a share from $5.26 a share.
-- said cut the 12-month price target to $109 from $117.
-- Agouron gained 1-3/4 to 63-1/4 in afternoon trading.
